method: Revalidate all 2,824 complete original contexts and preserve every prior non-null segment geometry hash. The initial platform stage adds BLS IR17 Bern terminal and SBB IC81 Interlaken associations. The subsequent completion stage separately pins its baseline and checks only the four S23/S26 pairs and reviewed seasonal service-road pairs, with existing full-pattern consensus and unchanged limits. Count excluded journeys once per route; failed-pair occurrences may overlap.

policy.method: Exact IC61/ICE/IC81 route and original Interlaken Ost platform 5/7 crosswalk to the FOT node explicitly labelled tracks 5–8. Coordinates, platform labels and all original calls remain unchanged. Full-pattern standard-gauge routing and all-context consensus still apply. Only previously unmatched segments can use reviewed results; no attachment or detour limits are widened.

sources.role: SBB station exterior plan, page 3: tracks 49/50 at western end of Bern. Station extent and platform identity evidence; not a surveyed track/switch alignment.

policy.method: Only exact reviewed route/operator identities with one terminal Bern call on original platforms 49/50 and the explicit adjacent operating point. Project platform onto the pinned SBB station curve and retain its station-centre side as an inferred terminal spur. Original Bern node stays in place; only Bern Wyler eastern approach remains connected at that node in the pattern-local graph. Full-context consensus and existing source validity, station/topology attachment, detour and stop-order guards remain. Preserve all previous successful paths. No running-track, switch or present-day itinerary certification.

Only the exact SBB S26 Aarau platform 5 → Olten platform 9 pair and four reviewed seasonal S23/S26 pairs may use the pattern-local standard-gauge FOT graph with the independently sourced, original 44-vertex SBB DK–DKO curve. Keep the metre-gauge FOT record unchanged and excluded. Match the entire ordered stop chain with all intermediate calls blocked against revisiting and require all twelve-date contexts to agree. Preserve prior successful geometry, original calls and all attachment/detour limits; no running-track or effective alignment certification.

source.alignmentValidity: Publication and processing dates are not an individual feature survey date or proof of September diversions.
source.model: Complete selected graphical linework with exact operating-point crosswalk and measured timetable endpoint connectors; no midpoint splicing, gauge edits or use of schematic two-point records.

policy.method: Only five explicitly reviewed winter/summer directed pairs on BOGG 507/N51 and SBB EV1 may use unanimous complete-pattern results from the retained service-road profile with 20 m stop candidates. All 50 complete patterns on all three routes retained; no fallback, import issue, failed consensus or detour override admitted. Preserve earlier successful geometry. Partial EV1 improvement is audited but never emits an incomplete journey.
